deals.comment: LINE GAMES Corporation agreed to acquire 28.8% stake in Publishing Investing in Games Co.,Ltd. from Hooseok Jung, Howon Im, Junyoung Jeon, and Woochul Kwon for KRW 2.1 billion on August 25, 2017. Under the terms of the transaction, LINE GAMES will acquire 0.03 million shares at KRW 72,917 per share. from Hooseok Jung, Howon Im, Junyoung Jeon, and Woochul Kwon will transfer 14.4%, 6.84%, 6.84%, and 0.72% stake respectively. The transaction was resolved by the board of directors of LINE GAMES Corporation. The transaction is expected to close on September 1, 2017.

LINE GAMES Corporation agreed to acquire STAIRS Corporation from NextFloor Corporation for ¥99.9 million on September 29, 2017. Under the terms of the transaction, LINE GAMES Corporation will acquire approximately 2 million shares at ¥50 per share. The transaction was resolved by the Board of Directors of LINE GAMES Corporation on September 29, 2017. The transaction is expected to close on October 13, 2017.

LINE GAMES Corporation agreed to acquire additional 28.8% stake in Publishing Investing in Games Co.,Ltd. from Jung, Hooseok and 3 other shareholders for KRW 2.1 billion on December 19, 2017. As per the terms of the transaction, 28,800 shares will be acquired at a price of KRW 72,917 per share. After transaction closing, LINE GAMES Corporation will hold 65,600 shares representing 65.6% stake in Publishing Investing in Games Co.,Ltd. The transaction is expected to close on December 22, 2017.

LINE GAMES Corporation agreed to acquire Zero Games Co., Ltd. for KRW 32 billion on March 31, 2020. The consideration will be paid in cash and stock. LINE GAMES will purchase 40,000 shares of Zero Games. Zero Games generated revenues of KRW 7,029 million, net income of KRW 1,737 million, total assets of KRW 2,977 million and total capital of KRW 1,937 million. The Board of Directors resolved the transaction.

LINE GAMES Corporation agreed to acquire additional 3% stake in UJU Electronics Co. Ltd (KOSDAQ:A065680) for KRW 21.6 billion on June 7, 2021. Board of Directors of LINE GAMES approved the transaction. Transaction is expected to close on June 8, 2021.

An unknown buyer agreed to acquire 15.15% stake in Needs Games Inc. from LINE GAMES Corporation for KRW 1.4 billion on July 5, 2023. The deal has been approved by board of directors of LINE GAMES Corporation. The deal is expected to be completed by August 8, 2023.
MAXST Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A377030) agreed to acquire a 70.76% stake in Needs Games Inc. from LINE GAMES Corporation for KRW 6 billion on January 22, 2024.
